description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) "1. Why did God not kill the devil? Do we know the background of sports? And should we as Christians get involved in sports? Should christian kids play video games?"
.
2.) " Why do Adventist and Jews not keep the 7th day holy which is Saturday the Sabbath?  Exodus 16:23 clearly states six days, were they to gather manna. On the sixth day, which is preparation day they were to pick up double for the next day Sabbath not for later on on the sixth day when the sunset the Bible doesn’t say that the Bible clearly says the word tomorrow not in a few hours. Also, the walls of Jericho.  Joshua 6:3-4 clearly states for six days Sunday through Friday. They would march around the walls of Jericho one time but on the seventh day Saturday they would march around it seven times when you reread it it does not say on the six day when the sun sets march around it seven times it says tomorrow, the seventh day, Sabbath Saturday in any language is a form of Saturday like Sabado the seventh day of the week….Friday in any language is not! Leviticus 23 is talking about the feast days were to be kept from sundown to sundown but a day starts at dawn. It does not start at night even the birds know that and there’s many scriptures to support that God‘s mercy is new every morning when the day begins, the Bible doesn’t say his mercies are new at the end of the day at sunset a day never starts at night. In the creation, if you notice he created all day since the morning, then the evening came, then the morning came and he created all day and then the evening came, and then the morning came.  The six day is preparation day and it’s not the Sabbath."
.
3.) The Bible says...after the fall of man,God said,'Man has become like one of us knowing good and evil'...does it mean man didn't originally have this knowledge of good and evil before sin?
.
.
